title: Locations | AI Agency Melbourne & Australia | Crenosoft
desc: Crenosoft is managed from Melbourne and works with businesses across Victoria and Australia, in person and remotely.
lead: Our Australian team is managed from Melbourne. We run workshops in person across Greater Melbourne and deliver remotely to businesses right across Australia.
hero_cta: Book a Free AI AuditHow AI Employees work
body:
Melbourne and Victoria

We meet clients in person across Greater Melbourne, from the CBD, Docklands and Southbank to Richmond, South Yarra, Collingwood, St Kilda, Box Hill, Clayton, Dandenong and Footscray, as well as Geelong and the Mornington Peninsula. See our AI agency Melbourne page.

Across Australia

We work remotely with businesses in Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, the Gold Coast, Canberra, Hobart and Darwin, with video workshops and on-site visits for larger projects. Our pricing and team are the same wherever you are.

How remote projects work

  • Discovery workshops by video, with screen-sharing of your systems
  • Fortnightly check-ins and a shared project board
  • Testing sessions with your team online
  • Support and human review that works across all Australian time zones
